scenes.text: You can only pick one. Choose wisely.
Number one. Japanese A5 wagyu, the highest grade of beef.
Number two. A white truffle from Alba. One sold for over three hundred thousand dollars.
Number three. Caviar from the rare albino sturgeon.
Number four. A dessert wrapped in twenty-four karat gold.
Number five. The thousand dollar burger, with caviar and gold.
Comment your number. Follow for more.
